name: Godot Editor MCP (hybridindie/godot-mcp)
summary: Game-agnostic MCP server plus a Godot add-on that drives a live editor: inspect, edit scenes and scripts, run, simulate input, screenshot, profile and export.
description: 201 tools in 29 categories: an always-on core plus 28 toggleable toolsets, of which only `inspection` is on by default. FastMCP server (stdio/HTTP) talks to the add-on over WebSocket. PyPI `godot-editor-mcp` 2026.10.20.1, Python >=3.11. Project-defined tools via `## @mcp_tool` annotations.
